items.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...At that time, there was the Stan Kenton. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Stan Kenton, and it was also called the National Stage Band Camps.

ctx.x: If we may somewhat shift gears here, but this is looking at the origins and the history of the Jamey Aebersold Summer Camp. At that time, there was the Stan Kenton.
Stan Kenton, and it was also called the National Stage Band Camps. That’s Ken Morris, the fellow I showed you a picture of.
Can you talk about Ken a little bit more?
